name: Dreamland
source:
We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company "Watcher's Cargo." He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them.

The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices.

This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我们通过阿列克谢的眼睛看世界，他是物流公司“Watcher's Cargo”的一名普通工人。他早已不再和他的老熟人来往了。然而，在发生了几次不寻常的事件之后，阿列克谢开始看到符号。众人齐聚一堂，决定找出发生在他们身上的事件的根本原因。

年轻人穿越多个维度，解决沿途的谜题和人际冲突。但他们能否克服自我，解开这个故事呢？一切完全取决于玩家和他们的选择。

这个故事只是对一个广阔而神秘的梦境世界的短暂游览。会变成一场噩梦吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521580/]Steam[/url]]
